slides.title: Volta should enter Porto in spring 2027 by partnering with the city transit operator
points: Lisbon growth is slowing to 12% a year, so new cities are the next source of growth
Porto scores highest of the four cities we compared and has only one competitor
A partnership gets Volta to market in 6 months at less than half the upfront cost of going alone
Each bike would earn €420 a year after costs, but hills and safety need answers before launch

takeaways: Growth fell from 86% in 2023 to 12% in 2025
